I'm the administrative assistant within the team. My main responsibilities are: 
Monitor past due accounts of members on a weekly basis.
Assist in exiting members should they cancel their accounts.

Upload new documents shared in Amazon FB group in the Document archives

Wild Apricot

1. Member Exit process - this specific procedure is a guide on what to respond when members request to cancel their membership, and how to  remove members from MDS.
2. Past Due Renewal process - this is a step-by-step instructions on how we inform members who have not paid their membership fees yet, and what to do when we have exhausted all efforts to reach out to them.
Referral credits - how to identify which particular member needs to be credited, and what the steps are when we need to issue credits.
Non-Renewal process - this is the task where we discuss members who want to cancel their membership accounts.

Best Practice: In the technical sense, when dealing with Wild Apricot, I consult their Help Center when editing invoices or updating membership levels. They have a good reference guide.

Tip: For copy and paste multiple items in different times, I use Ditto, so I don't have to repeatedly go back to documents that I wanted to copy and paste. 

Tip: I use the "Template" feature in Gmail to store my email templates when informing members of their past due accounts.

I think it would be the new member flow where the payments from new applicants need to be monitored in order for their status to be changed from "Pending Payment Membership" to "Pending Group Entrance" status. 

Relevant document: MDS Member Flow - https://docs.google.com/document/d/17cfIK_WhFAl7vrpokiIrV9dGDu9FjBdxHPbCN-GG6-0/edit#heading=h.mgrcjhsarb3u
It would be the census link or the existing application link that are shared with the members if they need to update their status or gain access to MDS benefits.
Video tutorials are much more detailed and clear.
